subject: sentences
title: He, she, it, they
about: He swaps a name or a thing for the pronoun that stands in for it: Mia has a cat, she has a cat; give the ball to Ben, give the ball to him. Personal pronouns (I, me, he, him, she, her, it, we, us, they, them) are the Pronouns row of NC's K-1 grammar continuum under L.1.1, and CKLA matches pronouns to nouns in Unit 6.
tip: Ask who the blank is standing in for, then read the sentence back with his choice in it and ask if it sounds right.

cards.q: Mia has a cat. ___ has a cat.
cards.sayQ: Mia has a cat. Blank has a cat. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: She stands in for Mia. Mia is a girl, so we say she.

cards.q: Ben can run fast. ___ can run fast.
cards.sayQ: Ben can run fast. Blank can run fast. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: He stands in for Ben. Ben is a boy, so we say he.

cards.q: The ball is red. ___ is red.
cards.sayQ: The ball is red. Blank is red. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: It stands in for a thing, like a ball.

cards.q: Ava and Max like to swim. ___ like to swim.
cards.sayQ: Ava and Max like to swim. Blank like to swim. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Ava and Max are two people. They stands in for more than one.

cards.q: Zoe and I ate lunch. ___ ate lunch.
cards.sayQ: Zoe and I ate lunch. Blank ate lunch. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Zoe and I together are we. We means me and someone else.

cards.sayQ: The frogs hop. Blank hop. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: More than one frog, so we say they. It would be for just one frog.

cards.sayQ: Dad is tall. Blank is tall. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Dad is a man, so we say he.

cards.q: The sun is hot. ___ is hot.
cards.sayQ: The sun is hot. Blank is hot. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: The sun is a thing, and there is just one, so we say it.

cards.q: Give the ball to Ben. Give the ball to ___.
cards.sayQ: Give the ball to Ben. Give the ball to blank. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: After a word like to, we say him, not he. Ben is a boy, so him.

cards.sayQ: I see Mia. I see blank. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: After see, we say her, not she. Mia is a girl, so her.

cards.q: Sam is with Ava and Max. Sam is with ___.
cards.sayQ: Sam is with Ava and Max. Sam is with blank. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Ava and Max are two people. After with, we say them.

cards.q: The cat sat on the box. The cat sat on ___.
cards.sayQ: The cat sat on the box. The cat sat on blank. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: A box is a thing, and there is just one, so we say it.

cards.q: Can you help ___? I am stuck.
cards.sayQ: Can you help blank? I am stuck. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: After help, we say me, not I. I am the one who needs help.

cards.q: Zoe and ___ went to the park.
cards.sayQ: Zoe and blank went to the park. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Take Zoe out and try it: I went to the park, not me went to the park. So it is Zoe and I.

cards.q: Mia and I need help. Can you help ___?
cards.sayQ: Mia and I need help. Can you help blank? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Mia and I together are us. After help, we say us, not we.

cards.q: Ben and Mia are here. ___ can play.
cards.sayQ: Ben and Mia are here. Blank can play. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: They is the word that starts the sentence. Them comes after words like with or to.
